sentences.text: On February 2, 2026, Hobbleton Family Clinic documented left wrist pain 4/10, a splint applied, and a return in 2 weeks.
On March 12, 2026, Hobbleton Family Clinic documented that the patient called to request a work note and that a work note was provided.
On March 30, 2026, Hobbleton Family Clinic documented left wrist pain 3/10 and that the splint was removed.
On April 13, 2026, Hobbleton Family Clinic documented pain 1/10 and that the patient was released from care.
